assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original game environment background for Battle Link, trainer vespera; also usable as a 2D side-view battle arena.
Primary request: paint a unique standalone wide landscape environment, 16:9 composition. Moonlit gothic garden of forgotten souls, black iron archways and weathered lunar motifs on mausoleum stones at the sides, restrained violet spirit lights and distant moon. Gentle, reserved atmosphere; purple-black, plum and lavender.
Style/medium: polished anime fantasy game background, hand-painted detail, soft clear cel shading, consistent coherent perspective, crisp high resolution.
Composition/framing: landscape wide view with horizon across upper third, spacious empty flat arena floor across lower two thirds for two battling creatures; character area on far right edge. Focal architecture and decorative accents in distant backdrop and outer edges; keep central floor quiet and readable. This is background art, no UI.
Constraints: NO characters, NO creatures, NO humans, NO Pokemon, NO interface, NO borders, NO logos, NO readable text, NO watermark. No large foreground objects that obstruct combat positions. Opaque landscape background.
